paragraphs: Outsight sells software that turns 3D sensor feeds into a running account of how people, vehicles, and robots move through a site. The buyers are operators of large shared spaces such as airports, hospitals, and factories.

Anything entering the scene is given an anonymous identifier and held to centimeter precision until it leaves. No faces or plates are captured, only the geometry of motion. Operators define zones and the measures they care about, such as counting, density, queue length, wait time and throughput, and the analytics engine computes them continuously. Results come back as live 3D playback, custom indicators, alerts, dashboards, and APIs. Before any of that, a multi-vendor simulator tests layouts and sensor mixes and proposes the hardware configuration.

The company says the platform is deployed at scale across five continents. It calls the result a Motional Digital Twin and says these are running in production. Its newsroom announces a strategic partnership with AWS around spatial AI in aviation. The pitch behind all of it is that movement is the next layer of business to be digitized.

quote.text: The bottleneck of Physical AI is not models, it is real-world data
